collection.selected_scope: all official main-race predictions plus stratified samples from 1R-12R
collection.public_disclosure: research-purpose, aggregate progress, category-level progress, promotion criteria and findings only

sampling.shortage_policy: take all available races in the category and record the shortfall; do not substitute from another category
sampling.selection_policy: deterministic hash ranking within each category; selection must be reproducible from week_id, race_id and seed_namespace

interpretation.next_step: Accumulate category x regime coverage, then estimate uncertainty/shrinkage as a separate challenger.
